definitions.explanation: A hot spring that periodically erupts, shooting hot water and steam high into the air at more or less regular intervals. Found in volcanic regions.

examples.japanese: {間欠泉|かんけつせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}した→噴き出す：29265_fukidasu⟧。
アイスランド⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{間欠泉|かんけつせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。

⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噴|ふ}き{上|あ}げる{間欠泉|かんけつせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見入|みい}っていた→見入る：16142_miiru⟧。
examples.english: The tourists gazed at the geyser that spouted hot water at regular intervals.

notes:
A hot spring that erupts periodically rather than flowing steadily. Written with {欠|けつ} today, though the older form {間歇泉|かんけつせん} is sometimes seen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間欠泉|かんけつせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す→噴き出す：29265_fukidasu⟧: a geyser spouts
- {間欠泉|かんけつせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噴出|ふんしゅつ}→噴出：18287_funshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a geyser erupts
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{間欠泉|かんけつせん}: a natural geyser
